title: Easy Gooey American Cheese Casserole
description: A yeasty and gooey American dish perfect for a post-workout meal, featuring apricot jam and a keto-friendly twist, cooked to perfection in a bain-marie.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, eggs, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked ground beef, American cheese slices, apricot jam, and shredded cheddar cheese to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and place it in a larger baking dish or roasting pan.
Add enough hot water to the larger baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the smaller baking dish, creating a bain-marie.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the casserole is set and the cheese is melted and gooey.
Remove the casserole from the bain-marie and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
